'''2007 Pennsylvania State Championship Benjamin D. Kline LS Mind What You Have Learned''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Benjamin D. Kline]] at [[2007 Pennsylvania State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can|SE-L-mindwhatyouhavelearned.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Saucy Training
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
